summary: Insert AbstractWhy do 95% of GenAI projects fail to reach production? Because an LLM without enterprise context is “brain-dead,” a powerful engine with no nervous system to connect it to business data. This explores why context engineering is the missing link, how Knowledge Graphs power GraphRAG to improve accuracy up to 3x, and how Prospa, Australia’s leading online business lender, cut loan approval times from 48 hours to 2 using this approach.
